# List Convex deployment regions (`list_convex_deployment_regions`)

MCP tool `convex_listDeploymentRegions` · scope `access_provider_connections` · read_only

Lists the production deployment regions currently available to the selected organization's connected
Convex team. The result also returns the organization's default for new projects. It is US East when
the organization has no saved value. Availability is live Convex data. Selecting another region for
one project does not change the organization default. This action does not modify Samebase or
Convex.

## Arguments

- `githubOwnerLogin` (string, required): GitHub owner login for the Samebase organization.

## Returns

JSON Schema for the tool's `structuredContent`:

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "defaultRegion": {
      "anyOf": [
        {
          "const": "aws-us-east-1"
        },
        {
          "const": "aws-eu-west-1"
        }
      ]
    },
    "regions": {
      "type": "array",
      "items": {
        "type": "object",
        "properties": {
          "name": {
            "anyOf": [
              {
                "const": "aws-us-east-1"
              },
              {
                "const": "aws-eu-west-1"
              }
            ]
          },
          "displayName": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "available": {
            "type": "boolean"
          }
        },
        "required": ["name", "displayName", "available"],
        "additionalProperties": false
      }
    }
  },
  "required": ["defaultRegion", "regions"],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
